name: Undercovered Heart
overview: After her partner’s murder is disguised as an overdose, determined narcotics officer Mary goes undercover as the secretary of notorious drug lord James Sinclair to uncover the truth and bring him to justice. But as she infiltrates his world, Mary discovers a man far more complex than the ruthless criminal she expected. Her growing bond with James’s innocent daughter, Lily, and her conflicted feelings toward James blur the line between duty and compassion, forcing Mary to question everything she believed as dangerous secrets begin to unfold.
